note: Which icons each surface's sprite holds (design 2027 §8). Run node tools/build-icon-sprite.js after editing. An icon is `name` (Outlined 400, optical size 24) or `name.style.size` (style default|wght500, size 20|24|40); a variant not vendored yet draws the default 24 glyph, which icon-vendored-test accepts. `scan` lists folders read for literal <k-icon name="..."> so the kit's own icons need no hand-kept list. No shell references a sprite yet (stage 1 adopts nothing); the first reference follows §21.3.

kit.note: Seed at stage 1 from the preview frames; stage 2 adds every icon the kit's components draw (assets/kit/*.js, through KiwiKit.icon) and scans assets/kit for literal <k-icon name> markup.

kds.note: The kitchen draws icons at weight 500 and optical size 40 at 32 px (§8). `error` is the one the spec names. Stage 3b: the lanes' own glyphs (the late word, the warning timer, the note, delivery, the ready time, recall, the unsynced line) and the newer sheet's close.

till.note: Stage 3a: the till adopts the kit's code doors behind kiwiSkin2027:till (the approval sheet and the staff pad): the pad's delete key and the sheet's close. Stage 3b: the till's own kitchen board on the kit's lanes (the late word, the warning timer, the note, delivery, the ready time, the recipe). Stage 4 (till core) grows it. Stage 4: the till frame on the kit (till.js, elements.js, overlays.js): every glyph its menu grid, bill, options, payment, tip popover, cash count, split and discount can draw. Stage 4 (10): the rail's four destinations (Floor, Takeaway, Waiting, Kitchen). Stage 4 (11): the sync indicator's icons (§10.26 rows 1 to 9).

dashboard.note: Stage 3a: the dashboard lock on the kit's pad behind kiwiSkin2027:dashboard. The pad's delete key and its Face ID key. Stage 5 (1): Home on the kit (the deltas, the order rows, the tile states). Stage 5 (2): Orders on the kit (the method icons, §18.2). Stage 5 (3): the Report's Export button. Stage 5 (4): Customers on the kit (the overflow, Add, the search field and its clear button). Stage 5 (6): Compliance's obligation icons. Stage 6: the onboarding's Back. Desktop (dash-desktop.js): the sidebar's destination glyphs, one per shipped link, category for the rest.

access.note: Stage 6: forgot and reset password (reset.html) behind kiwiSkin2027:access. The banners' and the field's icons.

team.note: Stage 3a: the team sign-in and the clock-in pad behind kiwiSkin2027:team. The pad's delete key.
